faqs.question: What is Korunet?
faqs.answer: Korunet is a platform for people to connect around new life, growth, strength, and peace through trusted circles, conversations, gatherings, and shared practices.

faqs.question: What can a circle be about?
faqs.answer: A circle can support a life transition, wellbeing practice, learning journey, creative goal, recovery process, local initiative, or any shared intention that benefits from community.

faqs.question: Can circles stay private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Circle hosts can choose who joins, what members can see, and which roles can guide or care for each space.

faqs.question: Does Korunet support multiple languages?
faqs.answer: Members can switch the interface language from the header or footer. This demo includes English, Spanish, and Chinese.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Create an account, share a little about the chapter you are in, and begin or join a circle that reflects where you want to grow.

LegalPage.title: Demo terms and privacy
LegalPage.description: Example content for this Supacharger demo. Replace this page with terms and a privacy policy appropriate to your application before launch.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
This demo is provided for evaluation, without guarantees of availability or suitability. Features and test data may change or be removed.

Use the demo lawfully. Do not abuse the service, attempt unauthorised access, or upload sensitive or confidential information. Keep your account credentials secure.

You may stop using the demo at any time. Access may be suspended to protect the service and its users.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
The demo processes the account details you provide, authentication information and data needed to run the features you use. Session cookies keep you signed in and remember preferences.

Configured hosting and authentication providers process information to operate the demo. Test accounts and their data may be deleted during maintenance. Do not submit sensitive personal information.

Use the available account settings to manage your profile or delete your account. A production application must publish its own contact details, retention periods and privacy information.

confirm-signup.title: Confirm your signup
paragraphs: Follow this link to confirm your user:

invite-user.title: You have been invited
paragraphs: You have been invited to create a user on {{ .SiteURL }}. Follow this link to accept the invite:

change-email-address.title: Confirm Change of Email
paragraphs: Follow this link to confirm the update of your email from {{ .Email }} to {{ .NewEmail }}:

password-changed.title: Your password has been changed
paragraphs: This is a confirmation that the password for your account {{ .Email }} has just been changed.
If you did not make this change, please contact support.

email-address-changed.title: Your email address has been changed
paragraphs: The email address for your account has been changed from {{ .OldEmail }} to {{ .Email }}.
If you did not make this change, please contact support.

mfa-method-removed.title: An MFA factor has been unenrolled
paragraphs: A factor ({{ .FactorType }}) has been unenrolled for your account {{ .Email }}.
If you did not make this change, please contact support immediately.

mfa-method-added.title: An MFA factor has been enrolled
paragraphs: A factor ({{ .FactorType }}) has been enrolled for your account {{ .Email }}.
If you did not make this change, please contact support immediately.

phone-number-changed.title: Your phone number has been changed
paragraphs: The phone number for your account has been changed from {{ .OldPhone }} to {{ .Phone }}.
If you did not make this change, please contact support immediately.

identity-linked.title: A sign-in method has been linked
paragraphs: Your {{ .Provider }} account was linked as a sign-in method for {{ .Email }}.
If you did not make this change, please contact support immediately.

identity-unlinked.title: A sign-in method has been removed
paragraphs: Your {{ .Provider }} account was removed as a sign-in method for {{ .Email }}.
If you did not make this change, please contact support immediately.
